text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn). Among 
the challengers from the Classic Class, 
only Symboli Kris S was seen as a hopeful 
contender for victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The opposition is stacked with powerhouses 
like Air Shakur and Narita Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Umamusume around her were 
awed by the aura Symboli Kris S radiated. 
Symboli Kris S psyched herself up, 
determined to execute a victory.
